envelope.description: Add the write side with the WriteJournal and recovery

body.title: Add the write side with the WriteJournal and recovery
body.summary: Add ArtifactStore.write and the WriteJournal port (stage, pending, clear) with an in-memory journal and a named non-durable constructor. The journal stages the whole immutable ChangeLogEntry with the prepared head; write completes any pending operation first, then stages, appends the log entry, replaces the head and clears; recovery appends the staged entry idempotently even when the head already matches. Validate the parent and artifact-typed references and merge the prior meta, replacing only meta.envelope, meta.lifecycle and meta.revision.
acceptanceChecks: only a content change moves the revision, and a description change is content
a failure at stage, log append, head replace and clear each leaves the documented state and the next write completes the staged operation under the same operation id with the log showing it once
a restart before the append, a retry by a different actor and an identical-head append failure all recover the original entry
the store merges prior meta and a store write followed by workItemAnchorCreatedAt and the Define renderer returns the same results as before the write
external references are accepted and a bad parent or artifact-typed reference is refused
